as_told.title: Friend's account of back-engineered and flown craft

plain: A friend of Robert Salas from the Air Force Academy, the US Air Force's officer school, told him he had actually flown a craft similar to a UFO. Salas, a former Air Force officer, repeats this to Michels and says that because of it he is convinced the United States has back-engineered, meaning copied the workings of, recovered craft and even flown some models. If true, the government would hold and fly technology built from crashed craft.
